title: Communications and Marketing Lead
description:
As a Marketing Lead in Haywards Heath, you will lead day-to-day marketing activity for a Not For Profit organisation and help keep communications clear and well organised. You will work across the Marketing & Agency department to plan, deliver and review campaigns that support the organisation's aims.

Client Details

The organisation operates within the Not For Profit sector in Haywards Heath.

Description
- Plan and deliver marketing activity that supports organisational priorities and keeps campaigns on track.
- Create clear marketing plans, setting out activity, timings and expected outcomes.
- Coordinate campaign delivery across relevant channels to ensure consistent messaging.
- Develop marketing content that communicates key information in a clear and accessible way.
- Review campaign performance and use findings to inform future marketing activity.
- Manage marketing schedules and priorities to support an organised workflow.
- Work with colleagues across the Marketing & Agency department to deliver joined-up activity.
- Maintain accurate records of marketing activity, plans and campaign results.

Profile

A successful 'Marketing Lead' should have:
- Experience of planning and delivering marketing campaigns.
- Ability to create clear marketing plans and manage campaign schedules.
- Experience of developing marketing content for different channels.
- Ability to review marketing activity and use campaign results to guide future work.
- Experience of coordinating marketing activity across teams or stakeholders.
- Strong organisational skills to manage several marketing priorities.

Job Offer
- Permanent Marketing Lead position based in Haywards Heath.
- Salary of 45,000 dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Communications Manager
description:
Communications Manager

Joining a team united by a shared commitment to making a real difference. An organisation promoting a culture of openness, learning, and accountability.

ABOUT YOU

Are you.

A skilled communications expert with significant professional experience in communications, media, public affairs, stakeholder engagement, or a closely related discipline?

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

title: Creative Content Lead
description:
Creative Content Lead
35,000 - 40,000, Haywards Heath, Monday to Friday, full-time, permanent, 20 days holiday rising with service, HealthShield cash plan, wellbeing benefits, staff discount, company events

The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Content & Creative Lead to join an established premium consumer brand in Haywards Heath. Working as part of the wider marketing and creative function and reporting to the Head of Retail, this is a hands-on position for someone who loves turning creative ideas into beautiful, commercially effective content. You will take ownership of day-to-day creative output across digital, paid media and print, while helping ensure every customer touchpoint reflects the quality and aspirational feel of the brand.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Create high-quality digital and static content for paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Meta and Google Performance Max
- Develop creative concepts and turn ideas into engaging, on-brand campaign assets
- Review paid media performance to understand which creative concepts are working and use these insights to continually improve future content
- Produce and manage digital and print assets including magazine advertising, point-of-sale materials and other above-the-line campaigns
- Support the planning and production of direct mail campaigns, considering audience, product focus, messaging and storytelling
- Coordinate photoshoots and content capture, ensuring post-shoot assets are edited and ready for use across relevant channels
- Edit video content and support the development of engaging video creative, where experience allows
- Use AI tools appropriately to increase creative output, develop variations and support planning and analysis
- Act as a guardian of the brand's visual identity, maintaining brand guidelines and ensuring content feels consistent across every customer touchpoint
- Work with external agencies, media partners and suppliers to ensure creative is delivered effectively and to deadline
- Support and develop a Junior Graphic Designer, helping to prioritise workload and maximise the creative resource available within the team
- Research emerging creative opportunities and channels, helping the brand explore areas such as TikTok, AI advertising and future media opportunities

Requirements
Previous experience within a hands-on creative, graphic design or content role is necessary, ideally with around three years or more experience in a commercially focused environment. Strong graphic design skills and proficiency with Adobe InDesign are highly desirable, alongside the ability to confidently create professional assets beyond template-led platforms such as Canva. Experience creating static content for paid advertising and an understanding of how creative can influence campaign performance would also be highly desirable.

You will be an ideas-driven and proactive creative who enjoys implementing your work rather than solely developing strategy. Experience within a premium, luxury, aspirational or high-consideration consumer environment would be desirable, although applications from other sectors with an appropriate creative style are welcomed. Video editing, shoot production, AI creative tools and previous mentoring or management experience would be advantageous but are not essential.

This role could suit someone who has worked as a Senior Graphic Designer, Senior Creative Designer or Creative Content Manager.

Company Information
Our client is an established and highly regarded premium consumer brand with a strong emphasis on beautiful design, aspirational content and an exceptional customer experience. The business has built a distinctive visual identity and places creativity at the heart of how it communicates with its customers.

You will join a collaborative marketing and creative environment where ideas are encouraged and where the Content & Creative Lead will have the opportunity to influence how the brand evolves across established and emerging channels. This is particularly well suited to someone who wants creative ownership while remaining close to the hands-on design and production work they enjoy.

Package
- 35,000 - 40,000 salary
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday
- 20 days' annual leave, increasing with length of service
- HealthShield cash plan
- Gym and wellbeing credits
- Staff discount
- Summer and Christmas company events
- Family-friendly approach
- Accessible Haywards Heath location with public transport links
- Nearby parking options

Travail Employment Group is operating as an Employment Agency. Once you click to apply for this job your application will be immediately received by Travail Employment Group. If your application is successful a consultant will be in contact with you within the next 7 days. If you do not hear within 7 days you have unfortunately not been successful on this occasion.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive
- Location: West Sussex
- Job Type: Full-time
- Salary: £28-35k

Are you a Digital Marketing Executive looking to join a creative team to enhance their online marketing efforts. The ideal candidate will be pivotal in driving brand awareness, generating leads, and improving customer engagement across various digital channels.

Day-to-day duties of the role:
- Plan, implement, and manage digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels such as SEO, PPC, email, social media, and display advertising.
- Monitor and analyse campaign performance using tools like Google Analytics, and report on ROI and key KPIs.
- Manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn.
- Support the content strategy by creating and scheduling engaging content across websites, blogs, and social platforms.
- Conduct keyword research and implement SEO best practices to enhance organic visibility.
- Manage social media accounts, including content planning, posting, and engagement.
- Assist in email marketing campaigns, from creation to performance tracking.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure brand consistency and campaign effectiveness.
- Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, and technologies.
- Support website updates and improvements to enhance user experience and conversion rates.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience in a digital marketing role or similar.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and techniques.
- Experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
- Familiarity with paid advertising platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
- Desirable skills include experience with CMS platforms like WordPress, knowledge of email marketing platforms like Mailchimp or HubSpot, basic understanding of HTML/CSS, experience with marketing automation tools, and graphic design skills using tools like Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunities for career progression.
- Ongoing training and professional development.
- A collaborative and dynamic working environment.

Please apply online now if you are interested in being considered for this role.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
As a Digital Marketing Executive, you'll play a key role in growing the reach, engagement and commercial success of British Baker and Restaurant, helping to connect industry professionals with the news, insights, events and business opportunities that matter most to them. Combining creativity with data-driven decision making, you'll help attract new audiences, strengthen existing relationships and deliver measurable results across multiple digital channels.

This role is currently based in Crawley and will relocate to our Brighton office from Spring 2027.

What You'll Be Doing
- Plan and deliver multi-channel digital marketing campaigns to promote British Baker, Restaurant, industry events and commercial products
- Create and manage email marketing campaigns, including audience selection, copywriting, campaign set-up and performance evaluation
- Maintain and update event and brand websites, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and aligned with brand guidelines
- Produce a range of marketing assets, including brochures, media kits, digital adverts and promotional materials
- Deliver social media activity that strengthens brand awareness, supports campaigns and increases audience engagement
- Monitor campaign and website performance, using insights and data to optimise future activity and improve results
- Work closely with colleagues across sales, editorial, events and marketing teams to coordinate activity, generate qualified commercial leads and identify opportunities for audience

What You'll Need
- Previous experience in a digital marketing role, with hands-on experience delivering campaigns across multiple digital channels
- Strong written communication skills with the ability to create engaging and accurate marketing copy for different audiences
- Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities while delivering high-quality work to deadline
- Confidence interpreting campaign and website performance data, using insights to inform future activity and improve results.
- A creative approach to problem-solving, strong attention to detail and an eye for effective digital content and design
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across marketing, sales, editorial and events teams
- A proactive and organised approach, with the confidence to take ownership of projects and identify opportunities to improve marketing performance

Benefits & Initiatives
- Generous annual leave -25 days plus standard England and Wales bank holidays for full-time employees
- Long service holiday reward - Receive an extra day's annual leave for each year of service after six years, up to a maximum of 30 days plus bank holidays for full-time colleagues
- Christmas office closure - Enjoy additional paid leave between Christmas Day and New Year's Day to cover discretionary office closure days
- Holiday purchase scheme - Buy up to three additional days' annual leave each year and spread the cost over up to six months
- MeDay - Take an additional paid day off to celebrate your birthday, a cultural or religious event, or another occasion that is meaningful to you
- Volunteering day - One paid day each year to support a charity, community group or cause close to your heart
- Hybrid and agile working - Flexible ways of working to help you balance work and life commitments (role dependent)
- Enhanced pension contributions - Benefit from employer pension contributions above the statutory minimum
- Life assurance - Providing financial protection and peace of mind for you and your loved ones
- Group Income Protection - Financial support if you're unable to work due to long-term illness or injury
- Family-friendly policies - Enhanced pay entitlements to support you and your family during important life events
- Health and wellbeing support, including:
- Healthcare cash plan
- Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
- Virtual GP service
- Health and wellbeing resources and tools
- Commitment to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion - Supported by employee-led networks, with a culture where everyone feels welcome and valued. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer
- Cycle to Work scheme - Save money and support a healthier commute
- Electric Car scheme - Access an affordable and sustainable way to drive an electric vehicle

title: Marketing & Membership Manager
description:
We are very pleased to be working alongside our reputable, friendly and highly established client as they seek to recruit a Marketing and Membership Manager into their team within their offices based close to Haywards Heath

Marketing and Membership Manager - office based role but with flexible working

Haywards Heath outskirts with free parking available for all staff on site. Due to workplace location it is essential to be a driver and have your own transport. Rural and beautiful office / workplace.

Full time permanent role - Monday - Friday (Apply online only)

Salary 37000- 38000 plus good pension scheme and 28 days annual leave (including bank holidays), Life assurance. An additional 3 days or annual leave are given due to Christmas shutdown

We are seeking an experienced and creative Marketing & Membership Manager to lead the marketing strategy for a well-established organisation. This is a varied and influential role responsible for driving admissions, membership growth, venue enquiries, educational programme engagement, and overall brand awareness. Working as part of the Senior Leadership Team (with one direct report), you will develop and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns, manage agency relationships, oversee membership activity, and support the long-term growth of the organisation.

The role - Marketing and Membership Manager

This opportunity would suit a proactive marketing professional with experience in event marketing, digital campaigns and stakeholder management

We are looking for a confident and commercially minded marketing professional who can successfully manage multiple projects while maintaining high standards and attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities include:

Marketing Strategy & Campaign Management
- Develop and implement the annual marketing strategy to support organisational objectives.
- Create and manage integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, social media, email, PR and advertising channels.
- Manage marketing plans that increase awareness of initiatives, educational programmes and venue hire services.
- Monitor campaign effectiveness and deliver data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.

Digital Marketing & Content
- Oversee website content, updates and ongoing development.
- Lead social media strategy, content planning and audience growth across multiple platforms.
- Manage email marketing campaigns and customer databases.
- Create compelling marketing content including website copy, newsletters, advertising and promotional materials.
- Utilise AI and emerging marketing technologies to improve efficiency, engagement and campaign performance.

Brand & Communications
- Act as a brand ambassador, ensuring consistent messaging across all channels.
- Coordinate production of marketing collateral including brochures, leaflets, event guides, signage and digital assets.
- Develop strong relationships with media partners and oversee PR activity.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
- Manage and develop the Membership & Marketing Administrator - reports direct to this position.
- Lead external marketing and PR agencies, ensuring effective delivery and value for money.
- Build strong relationships with suppliers and stakeholders.
- Contribute to Senior Leadership Team discussions and strategic decision-making.

Experience, knowledge and competencies required:
- Proven experience in a Marketing Manager or similar senior marketing role.
- Experience developing and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Strong digital marketing knowledge including social media, email marketing and website management.
- Excellent copywriting, communication and content creation skills.
- Experience managing external agencies, suppliers and stakeholders.
- Ability to analyse performance data and identify trends and opportunities.

title: Marketing - Community Coordinator
description:
ASL Technical is a specialist recruitment and solutions provider supporting the engineering and technology sectors. We work closely with innovative organisations and talented professionals, helping to build high-performing teams across the UK and beyond. Our client is an established marketing business specialising in the high-technology electronics sector. They work with innovative organisations across electronics, semiconductor, embedded systems, and advanced engineering, helping them build engaged audiences and drive growth through targeted digital marketing. Due to continued expansion, they are now looking for a Digital Marketing Community Coordinator to join their team. The Role This is a dynamic and hands-on position, ideal for someone who enjoys combining creativity with data-driven marketing. You will play a key role in managing digital campaigns, creating engaging content, and growing a highly technical engineering audience. Our client is looking for bold, brave individuals, not afraid to go the extra mile to get the job done. Key Responsibilities
- Support the growth and engagement of a community of electronics engineers
- Manage day-to-day community interactions, including responding to comments, messages, and discussions
- Assist with planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across email and social channels
- Create and schedule content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and email newsletters
- Maintain and manage weekly content calendars aligned to campaigns and events
- Track and report on campaign performance (engagement, reach, clicks, and website traffic)
- Produce regular performance reports with clear insights and recommendations
- Support webinar promotion and audience growth initiatives
- Assist with SEO optimisation across website content and campaigns
- Maintain data quality and segmentation across email and CRM platforms
- Generate new ideas to grow and engage the audience

Skills & Experience Required
- Experience in social media marketing, particularly LinkedIn and YouTube
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to write for a technical audience
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive improvements
- Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines
- Basic understanding of SEO principles (desirable)
- Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and reporting tools

Desirable Tools & Platforms
- HubSpot (CRM, email marketing, workflows)
- Mailchimp or similar email platforms
- Google Analytics
- YouTube Studio analytics
- LinkedIn campaign and page management tools

What They re Looking For
- Data-driven and goal-oriented
- Creative, with an eye for engaging content
- Proactive and takes ownership of tasks
- Curious and eager to learn about new technologies and engineering topics
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have (Not Essential)
- Interest in electronics, embedded systems, or engineering
- Experience with webinars, events, or video content
- Understanding of B2 B marketing or lead generation

Why Apply?
- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology clients
- Play a key role in growing a specialist engineering audience
- Join a collaborative and fast-growing marketing business
- Real scope to develop your digital marketing career

This vacancy is being advertised by ASL Technical. To apply, please submit your CV or get in touch for more information.

title: Marketing Operations Manager - Fixed-Term Contract
description:
Marketing Operations Manager - Fixed-Term Contract
East Grinstead, West Sussex
£50,000 per annum (pro rata)
Monday - Friday, 40 hours a week, worked 9am - 6pm

About us

An award-winning, market-leading 3 PL (third-party logistics provider), ILG specialises in high-quality order fulfilment and delivery services. Our customers are premium brands, many in the beauty, fashion and wellbeing sectors. Our mission is to help them succeed.

We are a people business, investing in training and development, recognising and rewarding our people's achievements and creating opportunities for them to progress within our business. If you want to develop an exciting career, learn from a friendly team and realise your full potential in a fast-growing company, this is the role for you.

The role

As Marketing Operations Manager, you'll be at the heart of how our marketing activity works, making sure our systems, data and processes are set up to deliver results.

You'll take ownership of HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub, ensuring leads are tracked effectively, automation runs smoothly, and we have clear insight into how marketing is contributing to our pipeline and growth.

Working closely with Marketing and Sales, you will:
- Own and optimise HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub
- Build and improve marketing automation, workflows and nurture journeys
- Ensure leads are tracked accurately from first touch through to customer
- Manage lead scoring, lifecycle stages and marketing attribution
- Keep marketing data clean, accurate and reliable
- Create dashboards and reporting that turn data into useful insights
- Support campaigns with segmentation, lists and automation
- Look for smarter ways to improve processes and reduce manual activity

Please be aware that this is a 6-month Fixed-Term Contract.

What we are looking for

We're looking for someone who loves making marketing systems work smarter and can turn data into meaningful insight.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong practical experience with HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub
- Experience with marketing automation, workflows and lead scoring
- A good understanding of attribution and lead tracking
- Strong analytical and data management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Experience working with Sales on lead management
- A proactive, organised and solutions-focused approach
- An understanding of GDPR and email marketing compliance

Benefits

- Pension, Life Assurance, Healthshield Cash Plan and Discount Perks

- Regular social events
- Employee assistance programme to promote mental health and wellbeing
- Cycle to work scheme

If successful, you will also need to pass a Basic Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check before starting employment.
